models.name: ROXXY BL-Control 725 S-BEC 4D
models.firmware_note: Order 1-01171; burst 35 A; pulse frequency 41.6 kHz; S-BEC 5.5 V max 2.0 A (burst 3 A)

entry.confirm_signal: Three-way tone sequence, a pause of about 3 s, then a longer fourth sound.
steps: Battery disconnected, transmitter on, throttle stick at maximum.
Connect a charged flight battery: three-way tone sequence.
After about 3 s a longer fourth sound.
Stick to minimum: ascending tone sequence, throttle calibrated, controller ready in standard mode.

announce.description: No numbered menu. The mode is chosen by the stick position at power-up (off for forward only, centre for forward and reverse). The ready signal is a three-way tone sequence followed by a fourth sound.

select.description: Stick at centre at power-up selects forward and reverse (4D).

skip.description: Stick at motor OFF at power-up selects normal forward-only operation.

scheme.confirm_signal: Three-way tone sequence followed by a fourth sound means ready.
scheme.description: The stick position at power-up picks the mode: motor OFF for forward only, centre for forward and reverse (4D). Throttle range is calibrated by powering up at maximum, waiting for the long fourth sound after about 3 s, and moving the stick to minimum.

values.name: forward only, stick at motor OFF at power-up
forward and reverse (4D), stick at centre at power-up
calibrate: maximum at power-up, minimum after the long fourth sound

unknowns: Tone durations and gaps: not stated.
Default mode: not stated; first manual step shows forward-only commissioning.
Whether the stored throttle range survives a power cycle: not stated.
How the controller stores or confirms the mode choice: the manual describes only the ready tones.
Item numbers 1 and 2 are the order of the manual's sections; the ESC does not sound them.
notes: The throttle-range calibration (maximum at power-up, minimum after the fourth sound) appears under 'Programming the Throttle' (steps 3.1-3.4) on page 4.
